components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary commit action for a form or task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--action); color: var(--on-action); font: 500 13px Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--action-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered secondary action beside a primary commit action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 500 13px Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--bg-base); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact field for collection configuration and numeric entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 600 11px Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text-primary); font: 13px Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { width: 200px; padding: 16px 0; background: var(--nav-bg); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-label { display: block; margin: 12px 0 6px; padding: 0 20px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nav-text) 35%, transparent); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 20px; border-left: 3px solid transparent; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nav-text) 65%, transparent); font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.1s; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--nav-text) 6%, transparent); color: var(--nav-text); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--score-color); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-left-color: var(--nav-active); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--score-color) 12%, transparent); color: var(--nav-text); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Score Indicator
components.description: A scan-friendly fitness score with a semantic tier dot.
components.css: .ds-score { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-score i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--score-high); } .ds-score strong { color: var(--score-high); font-size: 18px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-score:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bgg-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Shelf Judge is an Operate-mode workspace for judging a board game collection. It favors quiet, durable clarity: warm paper-like surfaces, charcoal navigation, compact data rows, and a small number of semantically meaningful accents. The visual system makes the collection and its scores legible rather than competing with them. The interface maintains an editorial restraint while serving dense administrative tasks. Borders, tonal surface changes, alignment, and tabular numerals establish hierarchy; color communicates action, score tiers, source provenance, and status. Light and dark themes preserve those role relationships rather than merely inverting colors.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces with a dark, persistent navigation rail.
Compact, scan-friendly typography and measured spacing.
Semantic accents reserved for actions, scores, sources, and states.
Flat surfaces organized by borders and tonal layering, with one elevated menu shadow.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Use an accent to communicate a domain meaning, not to decorate a neutral surface. Preserve the source-specific blue and violet language, and the green, olive, and red score scale.

rules.name: The Numbers-Align Rule
rules.body: Scores, weights, ranks, dates, and table values use tabular numerals and align to their comparison edge.

rules.name: The Rule-First Depth Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with the surface and border vocabulary before adding elevation; reserve shadows for overlays that must clearly float.

dos: Do preserve warm neutrals as the dominant surface language in both themes.
Do use compact uppercase labels to structure dense data, and tabular numerals to compare it.
Do retain semantic color boundaries for score tiers, BGG data, and personal overrides.
Do use borders and tonal surfaces to group information before reaching for shadows.
donts: Don't use action navy, amber, BGG blue, or override violet as arbitrary decoration.
Don't replace the dark navigation rail with a light card-like navigation treatment.
Don't introduce oversized rounding, oversized display typography, or expansive white space that weakens collection scanning.
Don't remove visible keyboard focus treatments or rely on color alone for a score or state.
